name: gridsim
description: GridSim's deterministic power-system solver for AI tools: build, solve, study and check networks on your own machine, offline, with a hash-chained study record. GridSim is installed separately.

gridsim_cli.title: GridSim program
gridsim_cli.description: Full path to the gridsim program of your GridSim installation. Leave empty to use gridsim on the PATH.

licence_file.title: GridSim licence file
licence_file.description: Path to your GridSim licence file (needed only for cases over 1,500 buses). Passed to GridSim as GRIDSIM_LICENCE_FILE; never read, printed or recorded by the plugin.

workspace.title: Workspace folder
workspace.description: Folder for cases, results and study records. Leave empty for a gridsim-workspace folder in the current project.

enable_compare.title: Validation tools (maintainer)
enable_compare.description: Turn on the validation tools (compare, crossval_single, divergence_triage, build_regression). They need the Lab Mode harness and its rival runtimes; leave off otherwise.

harness_path.title: Lab Mode harness folder
harness_path.description: Folder of the GridSim Lab Mode harness (the one holding run.py). Used only when the validation tools are on.

enable_caselab.title: Case lab (maintainer)
enable_caselab.description: Turn on the case lab (caselab_run, caselab_status, caselab_findings, caselab_reproduce, caselab_propose): generated cases compared with the rival tools, triaged and shrunk to minimal reproducers. Needs the validation tools on and the Lab Mode harness; leave off otherwise.

enable_rebuild.title: Rebuild on demand (maintainer)
enable_rebuild.description: Turn on rebuild_on_demand: a user-owned GridSim build, in a folder outside the source checkout, with allowlisted solver constants changed. Every such build is UNSUPPORTED. Leave off otherwise.

rebuild_dir.title: Rebuild folder
rebuild_dir.description: Folder for rebuild_on_demand's build copies, outside any GridSim checkout. Leave empty for .gridsim-mcp/rebuild in the workspace.
